title: Rav Ada Saba
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He and Mar Zutra, the sons of Rav Mari bar Isur, divided their property and came before Rav Ashi: [Kiddushin 65b](https://www.sefaria.org/Kiddushin.65b.9). [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=324&lang=en) proposes Rav Acha Saba.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Bavli gives Rav Ada Saba. Heilprin quotes Ada in the passage and explicitly proposes changing it to Acha.
